name: Modern farmhouse (abandoned)
description: Abandoned and overgrown: Modern rural two-storey farmhouse, 14 x 9 m: warm render over a brick plinth band, a steep standing-seam metal gable roof with a brick chimney, aluminium windows with precast sills, a full-width timber veranda with a lean-to metal roof on square posts. Enterable: living room, entrance hall and farm kitchen below, two bedrooms and a bathroom above, two stairs off the rear landing corridor.

steps.note: core A: level 0 up to the half landing
core B: level 1 down to the half landing
